clips.title: The story
paras: In Stonetalon, Mor'rogal has altered resonite crystals with shamanic magic. The Enchanted Resonite Crystal is made to break the cask holding Goggeroc.

Deep in the caverns of the Stonetalon Mountains, raw resonite crystals carry unusual harmonic and earthen properties. Shaman Mor'rogal sensed danger sleeping inside a sealed underground cask and altered the minerals with his elemental powers. The Enchanted Resonite Crystal can break the reinforced Resonite cask and rouse Goggeroc, a giant Earthen, while he is still dazed from his long sleep.
